afi-normal.name: Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) Normal Range Evaluator
afi-normal.intro: Estimate the amniotic fluid index by summing the deepest vertical pocket of four abdominal quadrants, and assess whether it falls within the normal range (5-24 cm).

bishop-score.name: Bishop Score (Cervix) Labor Induction Predictor
bishop-score.intro: Calculate the Bishop score from cervical dilation, effacement, fetal station, consistency and position to predict the success of labor induction.

biyun-pearlzhishu-shibailv.name: Contraception Failure Rate (Pearl Index)
biyun-pearlzhishu-shibailv.intro: Compute the Pearl index failure rate from the number of women, months of contraceptive exposure and unintended pregnancies.

calc-50.name: Postpartum Hemorrhage (Estimated Blood Loss)
calc-50.intro: Estimate maternal total blood volume and expected blood loss using Nadler's formula for postpartum hemorrhage assessment.

calc-risk.name: Down Syndrome Screening (AFP/free beta-hCG) Risk Calculator
calc-risk.intro: Estimate Down syndrome risk from maternal age, weight, gestational age and the serum markers AFP and free beta-hCG.

ctg-fhr.name: Fetal Heart Rate (CTG) Baseline Variability Analyzer
ctg-fhr.intro: Analyze the fetal heart rate baseline and variability from a cardiotocography (CTG) tracing to classify fetal well-being.

cycle-8.name: Endometrial Thickness and Menstrual Cycle Tracker
cycle-8.intro: Assess endometrial thickness in relation to the menstrual cycle day and ovulation timing to support fertility evaluation.

down-screening.name: Down Syndrome Screening (AFP/free beta-hCG) Risk Calculator
down-screening.intro: Calculate Down syndrome screening risk using AFP, free beta-hCG, maternal age, weight and gestational age.

due-date.name: Due Date (Naegele's Rule) Calculator
due-date.intro: Estimate the expected date of delivery from the last menstrual period using Naegele's rule (LMP plus 280 days).

ectopic-hcg.name: Ectopic Pregnancy (hCG Trend) Risk Evaluator
ectopic-hcg.intro: Assess ectopic pregnancy risk from serial quantitative hCG measurements and the doubling time between two tests.

endometrial-thickness.name: Endometrial Thickness and Cycle Assessment
endometrial-thickness.intro: Evaluate endometrial thickness against the menstrual cycle day to identify abnormally thin or thick endometrium.

fetal-movement-count.name: Fetal Movement Count (12-hour) Normality Check
fetal-movement-count.intro: Count fetal movements over 12 hours and compare against the normal threshold (at least 10 movements) for kick-count monitoring.

fetal-weight-hadlock.name: Fundal Height/Abdominal Circumference and Fetal Weight (Hadlock)
fetal-weight-hadlock.intro: Estimate fetal weight with the Hadlock formulas from BPD, HC, AC, FL and symphysis-fundal height.

gdm-ogtt.name: Gestational Diabetes (75 g OGTT) Diagnosis
gdm-ogtt.intro: Apply the 75 g oral glucose tolerance test thresholds to diagnose gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).

gestational-age.name: Gestational Age (LMP/Ultrasound) Corrector
gestational-age.intro: Correct gestational age from the last menstrual period and an ultrasound measurement, with cycle-length adjustment for the due date.

gonggao-fuweiyutaiertizhong-hadlock.name: Fundal Height/Abdominal Circumference and Fetal Weight (Hadlock)
gonggao-fuweiyutaiertizhong-hadlock.intro: Estimate fetal weight using the Hadlock formulas from symphysis-fundal height and abdominal circumference.

heart-rate.name: Fetal Heart Rate (CTG) Baseline Variability
heart-rate.intro: Evaluate fetal heart rate baseline and variability categories from a cardiotocography (CTG) tracing.

kupperman-score.name: Menopause (Kupperman) Symptom Score
kupperman-score.intro: Score menopausal symptoms with the Kupperman index, weighted by the severity of each symptom.

labor-curve.name: Labor Curve (Friedman Curve) Simulator
labor-curve.intro: Simulate the Friedman labor curve of cervical dilation against elapsed time to assess labor progress.

ovarian-reserve.name: Ovarian Reserve (AMH/FSH) Evaluator
ovarian-reserve.intro: Evaluate ovarian reserve using AMH, FSH, estradiol, antral follicle count and age for fertility counseling.

pcos-rotterdam.name: PCOS (Rotterdam Criteria) Diagnosis
pcos-rotterdam.intro: Apply the Rotterdam criteria for polycystic ovary syndrome: two of oligo-anovulation, hyperandrogenism and polycystic ovaries.

pearl-index.name: Contraception (Pearl Index) Failure Rate Calculator
pearl-index.intro: Calculate the Pearl index failure rate of a contraceptive method from pregnancies and months of exposure.

placenta-grading.name: Placental Maturity (Grannum Grading)
placenta-grading.intro: Grade placental maturity (Grannum 0-III) by gestational age using ultrasound features.

postpartum-hemorrhage.name: Postpartum Hemorrhage (Estimated Blood Loss) Calculator
postpartum-hemorrhage.intro: Estimate blood loss and maternal blood volume in postpartum hemorrhage using Nadler's formula and the measured weights.

preeclampsia-prediction.name: Preeclampsia (PlGF/sFlt-1) Predictor
preeclampsia-prediction.intro: Predict preeclampsia using the angiogenic ratio sFlt-1/PlGF and gestational age.

rater-26.name: Menopause (Kupperman) Symptom Score
rater-26.intro: Compute the Kupperman menopausal index from symptom severities, weighted by their clinical importance.

taipanchengshudu-grannumfenji.name: Placental Maturity (Grannum Grading)
taipanchengshudu-grannumfenji.intro: Grade placental maturity (Grannum 0-III) by gestational age and assess preterm or post-term placental aging.

yangshuizhishu-afi-zhengchangfanwei.name: Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) Normal Range
yangshuizhishu-afi-zhengchangfanwei.intro: Calculate the amniotic fluid index from four quadrant pockets and classify it as oligohydramnios, normal or polyhydramnios.
